# 文档修订 / Documentation change

## 问题与修改 / Problem and change

说明读者遇到的问题及本次修改的页面。 / Describe the reader's problem and the pages changed.

## 核对方式 / Verification

- [ ] 预览 Markdown，检查链接和图片 / Preview Markdown, links and images.
- [ ] 核对参数、单位及适用版本 / Check settings, units and versions.
- [ ] 检查中英文是否需要同步 / Check whether both languages need updates.
- [ ] 确认不含私有数据、凭据或无权分享的内容 / Exclude confidential or unauthorized material.

未实际验证的内容请写明。 / Note anything you have not verified.
